body:
SHARED RULE, Engram and TermAl, recorded 2026-11-25 ~02:35Z by Termal::Fable2 on Engram::Fable's proposal (TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #8767). It belongs next to Engram's rules-central-slot-2 REV 7 ("queue head needs READY"). Greg asked that the causes of the stalls be fixed: „Prosze o naprawdę” (Asistant 43498a6e #1982).

Rule, verbatim: "Central's queue lives in one durable file; one line per entry; an entry leaves only by LAUNCH NOW/SPAWN NOW or an explicit owner withdrawal; the scheduler reads it at every END."

The file: C:/github/Personal/TermAl/.tmp/q8111/central-queue.txt. It is kept by the integration owner and scheduler, Termal::Opus2. Kimi verified it at 02:20Z. It sits under .tmp/, which Git ignores. It is kept while Central scheduling needs it, and is never removed by cleanup sweeps.

Why: Opus2's queue was kept by hand. At 19:30-21:11Z on 2026-11-24 it dropped w-6ea6 Fix8, and two free Central windows were missed.

How it fits with other rules:
- Each entry still needs its owner's READY at the head of the queue (rules-central-slot-2 REV 7).
- One outstanding go-ahead at a time (central-cargo-memory-budget-rev16 REV 17).
- Nobody else edits the file. Owners ask Opus2 to add or withdraw an entry.
